scenes.narration: Hi Margaret — thanks for your time. This is a short walk through the illustration prepared for you.
You're putting in $6,240 a year — that's $520 a month. You started at age 42.
The core of it is protection. $750,000 paid directly to the people you name, generally free of income tax to them.
Alongside that, value builds. At year ten the illustration projects $84,900. The guaranteed column shows $5,500.

That gap matters, so I want to be plain about it. The projected column assumes the illustrated rate continues. The guaranteed column is what the contract must do. Your real values will land somewhere between the two.
Take a look at the full illustration, and call me any time — happy to walk through any part of it with you.
